title: feat(kube play): flag to specify resources (pods, secrets, volumes) labels #26450
body:
feat(kube play): add --label flag to specify resources (pods, secrets, volumes) labels

Adds a `-l/--label` CLI flag to `podman kube play` and wires it through the API, bindings, and ABI so user-provided labels are applied to pods, PVCs, and secrets created from Kubernetes YAML.

Closes #26450

```release-note
Add `-l/--label` flag to `podman kube play` to specify labels for generated pods, PVCs and secrets.
```
